Download **LootLedger.exe** and run it. No install needed.

## What's new in 0.5

- **New interface** in Material 3 style: light, dark or system theme, accent colours, higher contrast, corner shapes, density and text size. Changes apply immediately.
- **Customizable Overview:** add, remove, resize and drag cards, and reset to the default layout. Each stat is compared with the same days in the previous period.
- **Trends** by day, week or month, for 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or all time, as bars, a line or an area.
- **Statistics:** records and streaks, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, the game-mode breakdown and teammate comparison.
- **Matches:** search and filter. Select a match to see its chests by type and a timeline of its openings.
- **Openings:** filter, see when each opening happened in a match, and export the rows you can see as CSV or JSON.
- **Settings:** date, time and number formats, default date range, auto-watch, counting broken-open chests, shortcuts, settings export and import, and **Clear all data**, which saves a backup first.
- **Keyboard:** Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5 switch pages.

Your existing ledger opens unchanged.

## First launch

1. In Fortnite: **Settings → Game → Replays → Record Replays: On**.
2. Open LootLedger and play. Finished matches are added automatically.

The exe is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time (More info → Run anyway). It is built from this repository's source by GitHub Actions. Data is saved in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\LootLedger`.

## Not yet verified

Counting during a live match, drag-and-drop reordering and the global shortcuts on a real display. See [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/femboypuppy/LootLedger/blob/main/VALIDATION.md).
